title: Oven Roasted Syrian Black Beans Kebabs
description: A smoky and crispy Syrian dish featuring fermented black beans, perfect for a date night, with an ayurvedic-sattvic friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the fermented black beans to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated black beans onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each bean.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy and caramelized.
Flip the skewers halfway through the cooking time to ensure even cooking.
Remove the skewers from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
